## Every page opens, and CI keeps checking

The night before the cutover: every GET route opened against a seeded dealer, then a browser pass over the main screens with the console captured.

### The numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Web GET routes in the table | **220** |
| Without an id in the path | 97, all opened by the existing SmokeTest lists |
| With an id in the path | 123: **72 opened** against `Tests\PageSeed` (119 test cases, vehicle pages three to four times: complete, sold, bare, platform photos only), 17 are 301 aliases, 34 named in `NOT_COVERED` (writes on GET, third parties, files from a bucket, a guest token) |
| Server errors found | 10 distinct, **5 fixed here**, 5 left with a name |
| Browser pass | 54 screens plus a click-through of every tab and every `modal.get` button on 20 screens: **1 broken screen** (fixed), 2 console-only issues |

### The fatal the previous sweep stopped at

`settings/downloadshowroom` (the Download button on the Showroom settings tab) dies with a **PHP compile error** in `vendor/zanysoft/laravel-zip/src/Zip.php:405` (nested ternary without parentheses, rejected by PHP 8). No handler catches it: white page, no log line. Not fixed here, it needs the package replaced (`ZipArchive`, already used elsewhere). **`bevinding: showroom-download-fatale-fout`.**

### What did not open

| Route | Status | Exception | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| `offers/{id}`, `orders/{id}`, `orders/{uuid}/history` | 500 | `Undefined array key 0` in `_tabs_offerte/options.blade.php:71` / `_tabs_bestelbon/options.blade.php:78`, vehicle with euronorm 0 (any import without one) | **fixed** (`bevinding: offerte-bestelbon-zonder-euronorm`) |
| `transports/{uuid}` | 500 | `Attempt to read property "name" on null`, `Transport::getPickUpAddressAttribute` | **fixed** (`bevinding: transportmodal-zonder-land`) |
| `showroom/{hash}` | 500 | `Missing required parameter for [Route: dealer.index.image]`, dealer without a logo | **fixed** (`bevinding: showroom-dealer-zonder-logo`) |
| `export/{id}/create` | 500 | `manufacturer->name` on null, `export/createmodal.blade.php:5` | **fixed** (`bevinding: exportdialoog-wagen-zonder-merk`) |
| `/options` (settings) | 200, but the two sort-order columns were **empty** since PR ac354e6b | Blade never compiled the `<x-ui.input>` tags (single-quoted `onchange` with inner single quotes); Alpine logged `Unexpected token '>'` | **fixed** (`bevinding: kenmerken-volgorde-veld-verdwenen`) |
| `own-vehicles/{id}/edit`, `own-vehicles/create/{id}`, `ownvehicle/{id}/phototab` | 500 | `Undefined variable $formName`, `photos/stocklist.blade.php:38`, for a vehicle whose own photos were deleted while the platform copies stayed | **left**: photo tiles were in other hands tonight; one-line fix described (`bevinding: wagenfiche-enkel-platformfotos`, `nu`) |
| `stocklist/{id}` (owner previewing a vehicle without a make) | 500 | `manufacturer->name` on null, `stocklist/detail.blade.php` | **left**: buy-over flow was in other hands (`bevinding: stocklistdetail-wagen-zonder-merk`) |
| `settings/downloadshowroom` | fatal | `zanysoft/laravel-zip` compile error | **left** (`bevinding: showroom-download-fatale-fout`) |
| `orders/{id}` of another dealer | 500 | `Illuminate\Validation\UnauthorizedException` is not an HTTP exception (should be 403); same shape for `image/{path}` unknown file (500 instead of 404) | **left**, judgement (`bevinding: verkeerd-id-geeft-500`) |

Also written down: the same dealer-logo `LinkHelper::route(null)` pattern sits unguarded in four mails (`bevinding: mails-dealer-zonder-logo`), and the settings page builds the Google font picker even when the Website tab is not shown, which logs `Missing div with id="font-picker"` and a CORS error on every load (`bevinding: fontkiezer-zonder-websitetab`).

### JavaScript errors in the browser pass

- `/options`: `Alpine Expression Error: Unexpected token '>'` on `$option->sort_order` — the uncompiled component tags above. Fixed.
- `/settings` (every tab): `Missing div with id="font-picker"`, `Response has status code 0` (Google Fonts with an empty family). Console only. `bevinding: fontkiezer-zonder-websitetab`.
- `/relation/{id}/edit` and `/worklists/edit` opened directly: `$ is not defined`. Not a defect: both are `modal.get` fragments without a layout; through the modal they run fine.
- Nothing else. Tabs of the vehicle sheet (complete, sold, create form), stocklist detail, offers, orders, rentals, transports, contracts, exports, bidding detail, relations, worklists, settings, dealer edit, users, locations, merchants: no page errors, no failed same-origin requests apart from photo URLs pointing at the (dead) bucket.

### What the extended SmokeTest now covers

- `paginasMetId()`: 72 routes with an id, opened against `Tests\PageSeed` (one dealer with a complete, a sold, a bare, a soft-deleted and a platform-photos-only vehicle, a photo and its platform copy, damage, a relation, offer, order with contract and history row, rental, bidding with a bid, transport, location, dealer group, category group, option tree, release note, requirement, link). Ids encoded the way each controller decodes them (`b64:`, `raw:`, `str:` Crypt::encryptString, `crypt:` Crypt::encrypt, `slide:` for the showroom screenshot id).
- `NOT_COVERED`: every route with an id that is not opened, with its reason; `test_every_route_with_an_id_is_visited_or_named` fails when a new route is in neither list.
- `SKIPPED` now carries four named cases (`wagenfiche-enkel-platformfotos` three times, `stocklistdetail-wagen-zonder-merk` once); they turn green as soon as those files are fixed, and `test_skipped_routes_exist` checks the names still exist.
- The previous agent's `tests/PageSeed.php` was a good foundation and is kept, completed (photos, history, widgets, category group, unique contract key, euronorm) and used.

### Findings

Eleven findings, one file each under `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-15-*.md` (the new layout: no numbers, the file name is the identity; five `opgelost`, six `open`). The X table is untouched.

### Verification

`phpunit --filter='Smoke|RulesCoverage|RulesDocsBuild|CompiledViews|StylesheetSyntax|BuildContract|Transport'`: **OK, 269 tests, 1121 assertions, 4 skipped** (the named ones) on a fresh MySQL from `mysql-schema.sql` plus the post-2026-07-28 migrations. Seal closed throughout (AWS endpoint pointed at a dead port, no third party reached).

`phpunit.xml` gives the S3 disks a dead key and a closed endpoint: signing a photo URL needs a key, and without one the AWS SDK polls the EC2 metadata service for six seconds per photo and throws, which is what failed the first CI run of this PR (eight pages that open fine).

Supersedes #363 and #365: the same work, rebased, with the findings moved from the X table to one file each (the new layout). both can be closed.
